description: Create a reusable 'pay what you want' tip jar with ZERO setup, no account, no API key. The payer chooses the amount. Returns a shareable /tip url, an embeddable button, and a manage_url. Idempotent per wallet address: calling again updates the same tip jar. Non-custodial: funds settle directly to the address you provide.

address.description: Destination wallet; funds settle here. Shieldz never holds them.

email.description: Optional, lets the owner claim a dashboard later

slug.description: Optional custom URL slug; auto-generated if omitted

suggested_amounts_usd.description: Preset amount buttons in USD, e.g. [3, 5, 10]

title.description: Heading shown on the tip page, e.g. 'Buy me a coffee'

name: create_tip_jar
